summary:
**Market summary, session of 2026-11-12**

U.S. equities closed lower. SPY fell 0.35% and QQQ 0.32%, while the Russell 2000 (IWM) dropped 1.64%. Energy (XLE, +1.51%) was the only major sector gaining, and oil ETF USO rose 3.25%. Materials (XLB, -1.28%), industrials (XLI, -0.89%) and communication services (XLC, -0.96%) led sector declines. Gold (GLD) fell 2.82%, and long Treasuries (TLT) lost 1.48%. The dollar (UUP) edged up 0.24%.

Among single stocks, PLBL led gainers with a 28.8% rise. ADIG fell 49.9%, the steepest decline among losers. NVDA, SMCI and CRWV were among the most active by volume.

News flow centered on Merck (MRK), which received positive EU CHMP opinions for ENFLONSIA and WELIREG, and on Nvidia (NVDA), where headlines covered its leadership transition, a House committee subpoena threat, and a reaffirmed South Korea GPU supply commitment. Goldman Sachs published its 2027 global equity strategy outlook.
